text_en: Kitchen: counters and backsplash wiped, sink and faucet cleaned and shined, stovetop cleaned, outside of fridge, oven, dishwasher and microwave wiped, inside of microwave wiped, cabinet fronts spot-wiped, table and chairs wiped, floor vacuumed and mopped, trash taken out.

text_en: Every room: dusting of surfaces you can reach standing (no ladders over two steps), light switches and door handles wiped, carpets and rugs vacuumed, hard floors vacuumed and mopped, beds made (linens changed only if a fresh set is left on the bed), trash emptied.
text_es: Todas las habitaciones: se sacude el polvo de las superficies que se alcanzan de pie (sin escaleras de más de dos peldaños), se limpian los interruptores y las manijas de las puertas, se aspiran alfombras y tapetes, se aspiran y trapean los pisos duros, se tienden las camas (las sábanas se cambian solo si deja un juego limpio sobre la cama) y se vacía la basura.
